analysis.summaryJa: 二音節語で-er型とmore型の選択に迷う場合の自然な形と、good/well、bad/badly、many/much、littleなどの不規則変化を使い分ける。
grammarPoints: 二音節語には-er型・more型の両方が許容される語がある
比較標識を二重に重ねない
visualEvidence: 二音節語から二つの許容ルートへ分岐する図がある
moreと-erを重ねた形に禁止印が付く
不規則語が別の語形へ飛ぶ矢印で示される
量の多・少と質の良・悪が別列で整理される
commonTraps: more simplerのような二重比較を作らない
littleの量の比較とsmallの大きさを混同しない

questions.prompt: The revised forecast is ------- than the estimate issued last week.
questions.translationJa: 改訂予測は先週の見積もりより良いです。
questions.explanationJa: goodの比較級は不規則変化のbetterです。

questions.prompt: This branch received ------- complaints than any other branch in the region.
questions.translationJa: この支店は地域の他のどの支店より多くの苦情を受けました。
questions.explanationJa: manyの比較級はmoreです。

questions.prompt: The road conditions were ------- than the logistics team had anticipated.
questions.translationJa: 道路状況は物流チームの予想より悪かったです。
questions.explanationJa: badの比較級はworseです。

questions.prompt: Of the three maintenance plans, the basic plan requires the ------- paperwork.
questions.translationJa: 3つの保守プランの中で、基本プランが最も少ない書類で済みます。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算paperworkの最小量にはthe leastを使います。

questions.prompt: The new headset performs ------- in noisy rooms than the previous model.
questions.translationJa: 新しいヘッドセットは騒がしい部屋で旧型よりよく機能します。
questions.explanationJa: 副詞wellの比較級もbetterです。

questions.prompt: The second draft contains ------- errors than the first.
questions.translationJa: 第2稿は第1稿より誤りが少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数errorsにはfewerを使います。

questions.prompt: The audit found that one location had performed ------- than all the others.
questions.translationJa: 監査では、ある拠点が他のすべてより悪い実績だったと分かりました。
questions.explanationJa: thanに対応するbadlyの比較級worseが必要です。

questions.prompt: Among all submitted schedules, Ms. Novak's allows the ------- time for equipment testing.
questions.translationJa: 提出日程の中で、ノバクさんの案は機器試験時間が最も少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: 複数案の中の最小量はthe leastです。

questions.prompt: Customer satisfaction is ------- this quarter than it was last quarter.
questions.translationJa: 今四半期の顧客満足度は前四半期より高いです。
questions.explanationJa: higherだけで比較級なのでmoreを重ねません。

questions.prompt: The updated dashboard displays ------- information on a single screen than the old one.
questions.translationJa: 更新ダッシュボードは旧版より多くの情報を1画面に表示します。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算informationの比較量にはmoreを使います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two service results?

choices.A: This month's result is more better than last month's.
choices.B: This month's result is better than last month's.
choices.C: This month's result is gooder than last month's.
choices.D: This month's result is best than last month's.

questions.translationJa: 今月の結果は先月より良いです。
questions.explanationJa: betterにmoreを重ねない形が正しいです。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly identifies the poorest outcome?

choices.A: Route C had the baddest result.
choices.B: Route C had the more bad result.
choices.C: Route C had the worse result of all.
choices.D: Route C had the worst result.

questions.translationJa: C経路が最悪の結果でした。
questions.explanationJa: badの最上級はworstです。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares performance?

choices.A: The revised process works better than the original.
choices.B: The revised process works more well than the original.
choices.C: The revised process works weller than the original.
choices.D: The revised process works best than the original.

questions.translationJa: 改訂工程は元の工程よりうまく機能します。
questions.explanationJa: wellの比較級betterを使います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares quantities of luggage?

choices.A: The new policy permits littler luggage than before.
choices.B: The new policy permits least luggage than before.
choices.C: The new policy permits less luggage than before.
choices.D: The new policy permits more little luggage than before.

questions.translationJa: 新方針では以前より少ない荷物しか認められません。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算luggageの比較量はlessです。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two simple procedures?

choices.A: The new procedure is more simpler than the old one.
choices.B: The new procedure is most simple than the old one.
choices.C: The new procedure is simplest than the old one.
choices.D: The new procedure is simpler than the old one.

questions.translationJa: 新手順は旧手順より簡単です。
questions.explanationJa: simpler自体が比較級なのでmoreは不要です。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly identifies the largest amount?

choices.A: This option uses the more fuel of all.
choices.B: This option uses the muchest fuel.
choices.C: This option uses the most fuel.
choices.D: This option uses the mostest fuel.

questions.translationJa: この選択肢が最も多くの燃料を使います。
questions.explanationJa: muchの最上級はmostです。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two narrow paths?

choices.A: Path A is more narrower than Path B.
choices.B: Path A is narrower than Path B.
choices.C: Path A is most narrow than Path B.
choices.D: Path A is narrowest than Path B.

questions.translationJa: A通路はB通路より狭いです。
questions.explanationJa: narrowerにmoreを重ねません。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly states the minimum effort?

choices.A: Plan B requires the least effort.
choices.B: Plan B requires the littlest effort.
choices.C: Plan B requires the less effort of all.
choices.D: Plan B requires the most little effort.

questions.translationJa: B案が最も少ない労力で済みます。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算effortの最小量にはthe leastを使います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares error counts?

choices.A: The update produced less errors than expected.
choices.B: The update produced fewest errors than expected.
choices.C: The update produced more fewer errors than expected.
choices.D: The update produced fewer errors than expected.

questions.translationJa: 更新では予想より誤りが少なかったです。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数errorsにはfewerを使います。

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly compares two calm environments?

choices.A: The library is more calmer than the lobby.
choices.B: The library is calmer than the lobby.
choices.C: The library is calmest than the lobby.
choices.D: The library is most calm than the lobby.

questions.translationJa: 図書室はロビーより落ち着いています。
questions.explanationJa: calmerを単独で使い、moreは重ねません。

questions.prompt: The revised instructions are better than the original ones.

choices.A: The originals are the best version.
choices.D: The original instructions are not as good as the revised ones.

questions.translationJa: 改訂説明は元のものより良いです。
questions.explanationJa: better thanは反対側をnot as good asで表せます。

questions.prompt: The second shipment contained fewer damaged items than the first.

choices.A: The second had more damaged items.
choices.B: The first shipment contained more damaged items.
choices.C: Both had exactly the same count.

questions.translationJa: 第2便は第1便より破損品が少なかったです。
questions.explanationJa: fewerの逆方向では第1便の方が多いとなります。

questions.prompt: The weather became worse during the afternoon delivery window.

choices.B: The weather stayed exactly the same.
choices.C: Conditions were less favorable later in the day.

questions.translationJa: 午後の配送時間帯に天候が悪化しました。
questions.explanationJa: worseはbadの比較級で、後の状態がより悪いことです。

questions.prompt: Plan C requires the least maintenance of the three plans.

choices.A: The other plans require at least as much maintenance as Plan C.
choices.B: Plan C requires the most maintenance.

questions.translationJa: 3案のうちC案が最も保守量が少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: leastは他案がCより少なくないことを示します。

questions.prompt: The branch performed better after the staffing change.

choices.B: Its results improved after staffing was changed.
choices.D: The branch achieved the worst result.

questions.translationJa: 人員変更後、支店の実績は改善しました。
questions.explanationJa: performed betterは以前より結果が良くなった意味です。

questions.prompt: This option leaves less time for testing than the alternative.

choices.C: Testing is prohibited in both plans.
choices.D: The alternative provides more testing time.

questions.translationJa: この案は代替案より試験時間が少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: less timeの逆方向では代替案の時間が多いとなります。

questions.prompt: The updated portal receives more traffic than the old site did.

choices.A: Its visitor volume is higher than the old site's.
choices.B: The old site receives more traffic.

questions.translationJa: 更新ポータルは旧サイトより多くのアクセスを得ています。
questions.explanationJa: more trafficは不可算量が上回る意味です。

questions.prompt: Of all the vendors, Delta responded worst to the emergency.

choices.C: No vendor responded more poorly than Delta.

questions.translationJa: 全業者の中でデルタ社の緊急対応が最悪でした。
questions.explanationJa: worstはbadlyの最上級で、最も悪い対応を示します。

questions.prompt: The revised form asks for less personal information.

choices.A: It requests a smaller amount of personal information.
choices.B: It asks for more details than before.
choices.C: It contains the most questions of all.
choices.D: It does not request any business information.

questions.translationJa: 改訂用紙は個人情報の要求量が少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: less informationは不可算情報量がより少ないことです。

questions.prompt: The premium package offers the most support.

choices.A: It offers less support than every package.
choices.D: No package offers a greater amount of support.

questions.translationJa: プレミアムプランが最も多くの支援を提供します。
questions.explanationJa: most supportは支援量が最大であることを示します。

questions.prompt: The first software patch caused several crashes. The second patch is much ------- and has run for a week without failure.
questions.translationJa: 第2パッチははるかに良く、1週間障害なく動いています。
questions.explanationJa: goodの比較級betterをmuchで強調します。

questions.prompt: The old process required twelve signatures; the new one requires five. It involves ------- paperwork.
questions.translationJa: 新工程の書類作業量は少なくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: paperworkは不可算で二者比較にはlessを使います。

questions.prompt: Four teams missed the deadline, but Team R submitted two days late and with incomplete data. It performed the -------.
questions.translationJa: Rチームの実績が最悪でした。
questions.explanationJa: 四チームの中の最下位なのでworstです。

questions.prompt: The new layout shortened walking distance and reduced waiting. Employees now work ------- than before.
questions.translationJa: 従業員は以前より効率よく働いています。
questions.explanationJa: workを修飾するwellの比較級betterを用います。

questions.prompt: The revised checklist has 18 items instead of 31. Inspectors have ------- steps to complete.
questions.translationJa: 点検員が完了すべき手順は少なくなりました。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数stepsの二者比較にはfewerです。

questions.prompt: Fuel costs rose, traffic increased, and two trucks broke down. This was our ------- delivery week this year.
questions.translationJa: 今週は今年最悪の配送週でした。
questions.explanationJa: 今年という範囲の最上級はworstです。

questions.prompt: The revised contract removes three reporting duties. It places ------- responsibility on the local office.
questions.translationJa: 改訂契約は現地事務所の責任を少なくします。
questions.explanationJa: 不可算responsibilityの比較量にはlessです。

questions.prompt: The morning seminar had 80 attendees and the afternoon one had 135. The afternoon seminar had ------- participants.
questions.translationJa: 午後のセミナーの方が参加者が多かったです。
questions.explanationJa: many participantsの比較級はmore participantsです。

questions.prompt: The panel tested seven cleaning methods. Method L removed only 40 percent of the stain, the ------- result.
questions.translationJa: L法の除去率40パーセントが最悪の結果でした。
questions.explanationJa: 七方法の中の最悪を表すworstが必要です。

questions.prompt: The new printer uses 30 percent less ink while producing sharper text. Overall, it performs ------- than the old model.
questions.translationJa: 新プリンターは総合的に旧型より良く機能します。
questions.explanationJa: wellの比較級betterを単独で使います。
